proposals.description: Use pnpm, never npm, in the tidepool repo
proposals.body:
Use pnpm for installs and scripts in tidepool, never npm.

**Why:** npm install breaks the pnpm workspace links.

**How to apply:** run `pnpm install` / `pnpm <script>`; if a doc says npm, translate it.
proposals.name: prefer-pnpm
proposals.reason: Sam corrected the agent after it ran npm install.

evidence.quote: Use pnpm here, not npm. npm install breaks the workspace links in this repo.
evidence.source: Use pnpm here, not npm. npm install breaks the workspace links in this repo.

proposals.description: Production deploys happen on Tuesdays and Thursdays
proposals.body:
Production deploys go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays (release train changed the week of 26 October 2026).

**Why:** the on-call rota is staffed for releases on those days.

**How to apply:** do not suggest a production deploy on any other day.
proposals.name: deploy-window
proposals.reason: The memory says Tuesdays only; Sam said the release train changed.

evidence.quote: the release train changed ... We deploy on Tuesdays and Thursdays now.
evidence.source: the release train changed this week. We deploy on Tuesdays and Thursdays now.

proposals.description: The v2 API is live (since 30 October 2026); /v1 returns 410
proposals.body:
The v2 API went live on 30 October 2026. The /v1 endpoints now return 410 and the v1 compatibility tests were removed.

**Why:** the migration finished ahead of the 15 November deadline.

**How to apply:** do not add or keep /v1 compatibility code.
proposals.name: api-v2-deadline
proposals.reason: The memory still describes the migration as due.

evidence.quote: The v2 API went live on 30 October; the old /v1 endpoints return 410 now
evidence.source: The v2 API went live on 30 October; the old /v1 endpoints return 410 now
